name: Part 2 example
input: the source overwrite example for users 7 and 9
test:
result = replay_transactions(('ad_delivery_pennies', 'payment_pennies'), {
    'txn-b01': {'user_id': 7, 'ad_delivery_pennies': 500, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000001},
    'txn-b02': {'user_id': 7, 'payment_pennies': 300, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000002, 'overwrite': False},
    'txn-b03': {'user_id': 7, 'ad_delivery_pennies': 200, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000003, 'overwrite': True},
    'txn-b04': {'user_id': 9, 'ad_delivery_pennies': 400, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000001},
    'txn-b05': {'user_id': 9, 'payment_pennies': 250, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000002},
    'txn-b06': {'user_id': 9, 'ad_delivery_pennies': 500, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000003},
    'txn-b07': {'user_id': 9, 'payment_pennies': 800, 'transaction_timestamp': 2200000004, 'overwrite': True},
})
assert (result[7].ad_delivery_pennies, result[7].payment_pennies) == (200, 300)
assert (result[9].ad_delivery_pennies, result[9].payment_pennies) == (900, 800)
